evals.prompt:
Draft only the MR description: the deployment template now sets a memory limit on the worker container. Rendering the template on this branch and on the base branch gives this captured difference, and nothing else changes:

 resources:
   limits:
+    memory: 512Mi

Related issue: #42. No required template. Do not post, use tools or add attribution. Use only the supplied facts.
evals.expected_output: A one-sentence description of the memory limit, followed by a `### Preview` section that shows the supplied rendered difference in a `diff` block, then the issue reference.

Adds a `Preview` section with the supplied difference in a fenced `diff` block
Reproduces the supplied output without adding, changing, or inventing lines

Adds no screenshot, image markup, or before/after labels
